transcript.answer: The mapping is `ESCALATION_BY_KIND` in `apps/api/src/tools/defineTmsTool.ts`. It is a `Record<TmsFailureKind, EscalationTrigger | null>` keyed by the TMS client's own failure kinds, so a kind added to the client fails typecheck until it is mapped. The `answerFailed` function looks up the trigger and calls `escalation.mark(...)` when the trigger is non-null and a sessionId exists. Three kinds escalate: `unavailable` (5xx) maps to `tms_unavailable`, `timeout` maps to `tms_timeout`, and `customer_scope_conflict` maps to `customer_scope_conflict`. This last kind is the case where a TMS answer contradicts itself about its customer. All other kinds map to null and do not escalate: `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `not_found`, `rate_limited`, `network`, `invalid_response` and `unexpected`. They still render an error or not-found card.
